| What observability is required? | Record state transitions |

This diagram matches the schema 2.1.0 manifest.
WORK is a composite state with COLLECT as its initial substate.
Its CANCEL transition is inherited by both children.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> INIT
    state WORK {
        state "WORK.COLLECT" as COLLECT
        state "WORK.REVIEW" as REVIEW
        [*] --> COLLECT
        COLLECT --> REVIEW : DATA_READY [payload.checks_passed === true]
    }
    INIT --> COLLECT : RUNTIME_READY
    REVIEW --> DONE : HUMAN_APPROVED
    WORK --> CANCELLED : CANCEL
    DONE --> [*]
    CANCELLED --> [*]
```

COLLECT and REVIEW inside WORK represent WORK.COLLECT and WORK.REVIEW.
The two final arrows mark termination and are not additional runtime signals.
Review requires an explicit operator decision.
Fail-fast conditions stop dependent work in the current state without adding transitions.

  run_id: null

      - executor_coverage

    transitions:
